services.name: The Downwinder
services.desc: $45 per person for all daytime tours $55 per person for the sunset tour 1.5 Hours About - Come out and enjoy those summer breezes on a kayak or paddle board with our Original "Downwinder". We will take you up to 2 1/2 miles upwind by boat through the protected Corolla Marsh Estuary, then you get to enjoy the trip back at your own pace with the wind at your back. This tour has become a fast favorite of every group that has tried it. You can chose between single or double kayaks, with no experience necessary. Or you can chose a SUP, however you must have Stand Up Paddleboarding

services.name: Paddle Board Rental
services.desc: Paddle boarding is fun for everyone! We have a perfect location for both first timers and advanced paddlers. Enjoy easy access off of our dock and take in the breathtaking serenity of our Private Corolla Marsh Estuary!! 1 Hour: $45 2 Hour: $55 3 Hour: 1-3 Hour Options Available

services.name: Half Hour Wave Runner Rental
services.desc: Speed across the beautiful Currituck Sound on our brand new 4 strokes wave runners! You can speed across the warm, calm waters of the Currituck Sound and enjoy breathtaking views of the Currituck Lighthouse and historic Whalehead Club. We stock all Brand New First Class Yamaha 4-stroke Waverunners that can hold up to three people. We have the shortest distance to our riding area on the Outer Banks, to make switching riders and family members fast and easy. We have the largest riding area to ensure all drivers have space for safety and plenty of room to have fun! Wave Runner: $89 Great for Families!

services.name: Parasailing
services.desc: 500 feet $89 800 feet $104 In the air 10-12 minutes. Round trip on the boat 1 hour 15 minutes About Soar Up to 800 feet above Corolla Outer Banks!! One of our most popular activities. Fly double or triple flight with 500 or 800 feet of line to get the very best views of Corolla.Awesome fun for the entire family. We focus on safety and fun. First class experience with top of the line equipment and highly experienced captains and crew. Book now, spots fill up quick. Photo packages

services.name: Jet Ski Tour
services.desc: Speed across the beautiful Currituck Sound on our brand new 4 strokes wave runners! Corolla Jetski Tour. 1.5 hour tour. Cost is per jetski, which can be 1 or 2 riders. Want a little more room to cruise and explore the beautiful Corolla Outer Banks from the water? Want to possibly see the Corolla Wild Horses away from ANY people? We gotcha covered. Our awesome 90 min Corolla Waverunner Tour embarks from our location in Timbuck II in the center of Corolla. Depending on the weather conditions, we will then head out to see and explore up and down the Corolla sound side on our new, comfortable, Awesome 1 1/2hr Jetski Tour of Corolla!!

services.name: Two Hour Pontoon Rental
services.desc: Fun for the entire family! 2 Hour: $365 About Come aboard one of our luxurious Pontoon Boats. Bring the entire family, it’s fun for all ages! The best way to get the entire crew out on the beautiful Currituck Sound. Our Boats hold up to 16 people MAX! Have more than 16? That’s ok, we have more than one boat! Our Pontoon Boat Rentals include the boat, gas and lifejackets, and all required safety equipment. You have the option to rent one of our boats for 2 hours or 4 hours. The Currituck Sound offers all sorts of different wildlife. Whether you want to cruise around and sightsee, For up to 14 People

Coolers 2 Hour Corolla Cruise. 14 people max. World famous Sunsets, Family Favorite!!

quotes.text: I’ve been coming down for 5 years now, and I wouldn’t want to go anywhere else. They have everything greatly organized, plus the best wave runners, pontoons, paddle boards, and kayaks. The staff is well mannered and will help with everything I need. We highly recommend the waverunner tour and the sunset cruise Corolla Watersports is first class all the way

This is our 2nd year coming back to Corolla Watersports! The wave runners were so much fun! We had a blast! The staff is absolutely amazing! They give good through directions and are very friendly. Can't wait for next year and another adventure at CW! P.S Winnie is THE BEST!
Great staff, no wait times when you book online! So much fun my family went there twice in one week. Thanks for the great time! We will definitely see you again.
